summary: A space-drone instrument: a five-voice drone starts on power-up and you play a soft synth voice, swells and a looper over it, moving between scenes in a key.
features: Five drone voices on black keys; four-voice "VOX" synth on white keys
Looper that follows each scene's key; slow "TIDES" swell modulation
Shimmer reverb, ping-pong tape delay, dual filter; A/B sound morph
Six preset banks of scenes plus eight user slots
USB audio and MIDI: clock in or out, 44 CCs both ways, program changes

headings: tell me how you play it
